record.question: What must you do to create a printer pool containing four shared printers on your Windows NT Server computer?
options: Set up all the printers to share the same parallel part.
Set individual printer properties for each printer.
Set up all printers as network-interface printer devices.
Specify the same printer driver and settings for all printers.
record.explanation: Printer pools require the same driver and settings.
